faq3.title: Frequently asked questions
faq3.description: Quick answers to the questions students ask us most.

items.a: Yes. There is no charge for our advice or application support.

items.q: I don't have A-levels. Can I still go to university?
items.a: Often, yes. Options include Access to Higher Education courses, foundation years and Level 3–5 diplomas. We'll help you find the right route.
Absolutely. Many of the students we help are returning to study as adults, and universities welcome applicants with work and life experience.

items.q: How do I pay for university?
items.a: Most UK students can get a tuition fee loan and a maintenance loan from Student Finance England. You only start repaying once you earn over the threshold. We'll help you apply.
If you already have an HND or Foundation Degree, a top-up lets you complete a full bachelor's degree in around one year.
